core_obligations: Recall the functorial distinguished triangle i_*R H_T(E) -> E -> Rj_*(E|_U) -> for every E in D(O_X).
The functor E -> Rj_*(E|_U) commutes with direct sums on D_QCoh by the pushforward direct-sums lemma.

The source leaves out: a functorial triangle whose two outer terms commute with direct sums has its fibre commute with direct sums as well (direct sums of triangles are triangles); carry this as an explicit obligation.
Conclude by the i_*-equivalence that R H_T(⊕E_i) = ⊕ R H_T(E_i).
proof_roadmap: Support triangle; direct-sum transfer through the fibre; equivalence finish.
difficulty_reason: A short structural argument; the fibre-side direct-sum transfer is the one substantive step and is carried as an explicit obligation.
